acceptance.rationale: The current record branch accepts a supported status plus arbitrary result fields, while passed with unchanged context receives a no-change receipt at accept. Therefore a nonempty reserved findings/questions field can be hidden by a contradictory successful status and avoid the corresponding ordinary publication obligation; the retained source review identifies the exact path. Rejecting that contradiction at record is the smallest bounded repair for frozen report-only publication review results. Nonempty reserved top-level findings must declare findings, and questions must declare questions; mixed obligations reject instead of being silently discarded. Preserve empty reserved arrays, ordinary notes, nested arbitrary JSON and generic non-review plugin results. Validation failure must retain the original attempt without a successful result; actual host reconciliation remains the cleanup path. The prospective controlled cases cover the four contradictions and a separate valid arbitrary-annotation result without adding invocation, installation or publication authority.
